_README: The squad the agent reasons about. Until GW1 has been played this is
maintained by hand, because FPL keeps a team private until its first
deadline passes. Once GW1 is done, squad.py reconstructs all of this
automatically from the public endpoints (see PLAN.md section 2) and
team_id below becomes the only field that matters.
Players are listed by FPL web_name, with team where the name is
my_lineup (optional): your OWN captain/bench choice from the FPL app,
so the dashboard can show what you actually set instead of guessing.
Leave it null and the dashboard just lists your 15 with no captain or
bench guessed for you. Fill it in like:
(bench must be exactly 4 names, exactly one of them your reserve
goalkeeper -- his order in the list doesn't matter, the dashboard always
draws him first, matching the FPL app; the other three render in the
order given). Once GW1 is played and team_id is filled in, squad.py will
read this straight from the FPL API and this field stops being needed.
team_id_note: To be filled in after GW1 -- the Points tab URL will read /entry/<id>/event/1
history: 2026-07-27: Andrey Santos (MUN, £5.0m) -> Hughes (CRY, £4.5m). Santos had 1247 minutes and 47 points last season at £5.0m; Hughes played more (1560 minutes, 19 starts) for £0.5m less. Frees £0.5m into the bank.
2026-07-27: Kept Mosquera despite 986 minutes last season -- Saliba is injured with no return date and Mosquera is expected to start at centre-back. Recorded in overrides.json.

2026-07-27: squad updated from the FPL app (GW1, deadline Fri 21 Aug 18:30). Diop -> O'Shea (IPS, £4.0m), Konsa -> Mitchell (CRY, £4.5m), Calvert-Lewin -> Solanke (TOT, £6.0m). Now a 3-4-3 rather than 4-4-2. Cost £99.5m, £0.5m banked. Bench Boost and Triple Captain both still available.

2026-07-29: recorded my_lineup from the FPL app's Pick Team screen for GW1 -- captain Haaland, vice-captain B.Fernandes, bench order Mitchell, Hughes, O'Shea, then reserve keeper Steele. The dashboard's "My squad" tab now shows this exactly instead of a plain unordered list.
